title: Audit bundle
description: The signed body of an approval's audit bundle: what a `signed-export.schema.json` envelope of kind `audit-bundle` carries in `bundle` (decoded). Who decided a human review, when, why, and the evidence, signed by the deployment. 2.0.0: this describes the bundle the API exports (one approval, a detached signature over these bytes); 1.0.0 described a multi-approval format with an inline signature that the runtime never produced.

subjectKind.description: What the review was of: `tool-call:pending`, a session gate, a deployment…

subjectRef.description: The reviewed thing's own reference, by subject kind.

status.description: Only a decided approval is exported.

decision.description: The recorded decision; `null` when the approval ended without one (expired).

guardrailResults.description: The guardrail results that raised the review, when it came from one.

messages.description: The conversation messages of the approval's run, when asked for (`includeMessages`).
